limits: Consumed exploratory dates, one-layer research replay, no live changes. Value uses matched strict terminal-mark windows, risk uses all windows; missing-mark populations stay explicit. Identical configured caps do not establish matched risk. Model success requires nonincreasing actual inventory-square exposure against both comparators in every execution scenario. Larger size is judged separately against the same policy at five shares. Later-taker mark value is descriptive retained-order value, not an identified pure queue premium. Unknown taker identities and missing marks are excluded with counts, never silently zero-filled. Age500 is a sensitivity, not a calibrated venue rule or formal P&L bound. At least five later untouched complete days and live queue/fill/cancellation calibration remain necessary before a deployment claim.
